body:
Root CMR source-applicability authoring decision: adopt the exact 217 enumerated CAF ADM1 key/operand pairs as contextual for the bounded original CMR source-relative repair question.

Scope is ONLY the immutable proposal in the existing 48-file handoff, custody receipt https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/2649#issuecomment-6392049916 , archive SHA-256 04a9bd420d04738ad41f1a9afaa14f370562c808990bad5260b5815a9e82cedc. Independent exact scope/operand verification SHA-256 34535fae9cd060c5d6034368f8873c587021a9fb636cec7c6047771270645eac. Independent substantive assessment SHA-256 a0c99f5e0a12aaa9619afe3c4ff53a2ecdd62b39ec9ab1952dda64d8b9071205. Root read the full assessment. No raw coordinates or geometry are included in this summary.

The decision rests on cumulative subject-specific evidence: actual original target membership and land observations, institutionally corresponding commune/arrondissement and department evidence, retained target-relative WRI applications, actual original CAF source construction records and local primary-source/treaty readings. The specifically identified CAF1 depiction has schematic blank-outline provenance without a demonstrated fine local control/method that makes it a decisive veto for these otherwise supported source-relative subjects. This is not an accuracy certificate or a blanket preference based on country, date, name, empty mapped-owner arrays or majority vote.

The exact original full source family, consumed operand geometry identities, target-specific negative ordinals and all raw contacts must remain unchanged and reported. This is NOT a family-wide CAF1 exemption, declaration that the source is wrong, sovereign-border determination, geometry replacement or positive acceptance.

All 33 CAF2-conflicted cases retain those conflicts. All 217 retain their separately unadopted parent contacts; this decision does not resolve them. The accepted Ndélélé cell is excluded. Existing contrary-parent cases and other negatives remain untouched. The original CMR denominator remains 4,925, with 1 previously accepted and 4,924 pending; the diagnostic's 363 supported outcomes are not acceptance credit.

Team 2 may author the precisely bound decision through the existing adopted applicability route, retaining this provenance. Before a changed-semantics run, resolve the separately required parent dispositions through substantive evidence and review or retain their holds. Do not repeat one full original diagnostic separately for each subgroup or decision. Once the intended adopted semantic inputs are complete, perform only the genuinely required stock screening/qualification and conservation, with truthful CODE/DATA pins. No consumer weakening, synthetic source, arbitrary tolerance or shortcut around a real source/access hold is authorized.
